scope: Native GitHub-hosted Linux, macOS and Windows core synthetic regression suite. Core/test dependencies only; ten optional visual tests skip without torch. No font-corpus or model downloads.

observed_causes: Four tests used locale-dependent reads of UTF-8 product output.
A test-owned SQLite connection was not closed before replacing its database.
Two tests assumed the Git acquisition backend rather than selecting it explicitly.
ZIP filename normalization differed on Windows, bypassing the intended raw-name rejection assertion.

corrections: Made test fixture text boundaries explicitly UTF-8; product output was already UTF-8.
Closed the test-owned SQLite handle and hardened all Catalog constructor schema-failure paths to close their connection.
Selected the Git backend explicitly in checkout tests.
Validate ZipInfo.orig_filename before path normalization; preserve raw ZIP names in rejection fixtures. Content-addressed extraction already prevented demonstrated filesystem escape.
Made Git command output decoding and existing source-lock reads explicitly UTF-8; added multilingual and legacy-locale regressions.
not_established: Full collection acquisition and corpus indexing on Windows or Linux.
Optional FontCLIP model execution on Windows or CUDA.
Browser composition validation on Windows or a physical mobile device.
later_documentation_commits: This receipt names the tested source commit. Later documentation/evidence-only commits may not trigger the workflow.
